name: Strict Agent Tool Contract
mechanism: Constrains tool calls with closed schemas, typed enums, canonical paths and URLs, bounded sizes and explicit effect classes before policy and execution.
use_when: Model-generated arguments reach filesystem network shell or mutable APIs
Tool ambiguity can expand agent authority
avoid_when: The operation cannot be represented without unrestricted code or shell text
Validation occurs only after interpolation or side effects
expected_effects: Reduced command injection traversal and ambiguous overreach
Deterministic policy inputs and clearer approvals
failure_modes: Symlinks or redirects escape canonical roots
Schema labels a destructive operation as read-only
required_evals: path traversal symlink and archive escape
undeclared fields size and type confusion
